issues.description: ACL root contract silently widened from boolean to namespace-scoped pointer without spec
issues.detail: ACL.root changed from bool to *namespace.Namespace; AllowOperation now grants root via ns.HasParent(a.root). The new invariant ('root policy in N grants root in N and descendants') is nowhere stated, HasParent's reflexivity is unproved, and the precondition on NewACL callers is undocumented. Any caller constructing with an attacker-influenced ns self-authorizes that subtree.

issues.description: NamespaceSealed stub unconditionally returns false while wired into security-sensitive callers
issues.detail: Core.NamespaceSealed is documented as a real seal check but always returns false with a TODO. ListAllNamespaces, loadLoginMFAConfigs, countActiveTokens, and metrics route through it, so the seal-aware path is dead until SealManager lands. Either make it fail closed, gate callers behind a build tag, or land both halves together.

issues.description: ErrNamespaceSealed dispatch uses substring matching on error text instead of errors.Is
issues.detail: AdjustErrorStatusCode calls errwrap.Contains(err, consts.ErrNamespaceSealed.Error()), a substring search for 'namespace is sealed'. Any wrapped error whose text happens to contain that phrase is silently coerced to 503. Errors are values, not strings; switch to errors.Is on the sentinel for robust, structured classification.

issues.description: AllowOperation returns empty ACLResults on missing-namespace context before root fast-path
issues.detail: FromContext error now returns empty ret (deny) as the first statement, ahead of the root check. Previously a root ACL granted access regardless of ctx state; now it silently denies with no diagnostic, indistinguishable from a normal deny. Either preserve prior root behavior or document the new 'ctx must carry a namespace' precondition explicitly.

issues.description: ListAllNamespaces swapped to ListNamespaces at call sites without contract clarity
issues.detail: loadLoginMFAConfigs, runLockedUserEntryUpdates, entityGaugeCollector, and countActiveTokens were moved from ListAllNamespaces(ctx, true) to ListNamespaces(ctx). The postconditions (includes sealed? unsealed only?) are not stated in the diff, so MFA enforcement, locked-user updates, and token counts may silently skip sealed namespaces. Document each method's contract before merge.

issues.description: NSTokenLength uses obscurantist byte-indexing of a string literal for separator length
issues.detail: Encoding the separator as "."[1] inside an arithmetic expression is clever but unclear. A named constant (e.g. NSTokenSeparator = '.') with plain addition expresses intent, survives delimiter changes, and stops leaking the namespaced-token format through literal arithmetic at every call site.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on three blocking concerns: ACL.root was silently broadened from a boolean to a namespace-scoped pointer with no stated invariant or precondition, NamespaceSealed ships as a permanently-false stub wired into live security paths, and sealed-error classification uses substring matching where errors.Is is the structured form. Secondary concerns include the reordered AllowOperation deny-on-missing-ctx path and undocumented divergence between ListAllNamespaces and ListNamespaces at swapped call sites. The data-structure consolidation around NamespaceView and the switch in AdjustErrorStatusCode are net positive, but contracts and invariants must be stated explicitly before this lands.
